Sub: - Severe Cyclonic Storm “Murasu” [Pronunciation: Murasu] over Westcentral Bay of Bengal
The Severe Cyclonic Storm “Murasu” [Pronunciation: Murasu]” over Westcentral & adjoining Southwest
Bay of Bengal moved west-northwestwards with a speed of 22 kmph during past 06 hours and lay centered
at 0300 UTC of today, the 02nd November, 2026 over the Westcentral Bay of Bengal near Latitude 14.1°N
and Longitude 81.4°E, about 160 km east-southeast of Nellore (43245, Andhra Pradesh), 180 km northeast
of Chennai (43279, Tamil Nadu), 180 km east-southeast of Kavali (43243, Andhra Pradesh), 210 km
southeast of Ongole (43221, Andhra Pradesh) and 240 km south of Machilipatnam (43185, Andhra
Pradesh).
It is very likely to move northwestwards and cross south Andhra Pradesh coast as a Severe Cyclonic Storm
with wind speed of 100 to 110 kmph gusting to 120 kmph between Nellore(Andhra Pradesh, 43245) and
Narsapur (Andhra Pradesh, 43187) close to Ongole(Andhra Pradesh, 43221) during 1800-2200 UTC of
2nd November, 2026.
